    Goldenborn's Caldera¶

    A mountain of gold. A cave of hunger. A mind that has been thinking for centuries.

    Goldenborn's Caldera is a massive volcanic mountain in Dragonreach, West Erisdar. Its shape resembles Mount Fuji — a near-perfect cone rising from the rugged peaks — but what makes it remarkable is the gold. Pure gold decorations, hammered into the rock face by dragon claws millennia ago, cover portions of the mountain. They catch the light at dawn and glow like a second sun.

    Adventurers from across Ge'or dream of raiding the caldera. The gold is real. The rumors say there are tons of it — dragon hoards, imperial tribute, treasure accumulated over thousands of years. Most who go do not return.

    The Cave — Black Agent Concentration¶

    The caldera was the epicenter of Melberior's suicide spell during the Draconic War — the largest magical discharge in Ge'orian history. The spell pulled the black agent from the atmosphere, saturating the dead dragons and creating the Fallen Dragons.

    But most of it did not become dragons.

    Deep inside the caldera, in a cave system carved by volcanic heat and ancient magic, the largest concentration of black agent on Ge'or has been gathering for centuries — suckling magic from the mountain, the earth, the fallen dragons themselves. It never stopped. It never dispersed. It only grew.

    The Hivemind¶

    Over the centuries, the black agent inside the caldera developed something unprecedented: a hivemind. Akin to the Hybrian collective consciousness — but born from a different source, shaped by a different hatred.

    This hivemind hates the Hybrians. It was created by the weapon that destroyed the dragons, by the Shadows' own war, by the black agent they themselves engineered. Their enemy's enemy. It is not benevolent. It is not an ally. But its primary drive is opposition to the Shadows.

    The hivemind controls Dragonreach. Every Fallen Dragon — including Fireborn — answers to it. When Fireborn recognized the black agent, when he knew what it could do, when he healed Julian with it — that knowledge came from the hivemind. The dragon king was not merely a host. He was a node in a larger intelligence.

    Possession and Construction¶

    The hivemind possesses animals in the surrounding region — birds, wolves, mountain goats, insects — and uses them to build. Deep inside the caldera, a facility is taking shape: tools, relics, structures assembled by possessed creatures working in eerie coordination. No human has ever seen it. No one knows it exists.

    But the relics it produces sometimes escape. They appear in the lower valleys, in the treasure hunters' camps, in the markets of Augamouth and Astravayne. These relics fuel the endless raids on Dragonreach — and the endless deaths.

    The Gold Economy¶

    The gold on the caldera's flanks is real and vast. It drives a significant portion of the regional economy, attracting adventurers, treasure hunters, and prospectors. But the gold is a lure. Most who climb for it encounter the War Wolves, or the Fallen Dragons, or worse. The caldera takes more than it gives.

    Connections¶

    • Location: Dragonreach, West Erisdar
    • Contains: Largest concentration of Black Agent on Ge'or
    • Controls: Fallen Dragons, all of Dragonreach
    • Hivemind: Black Agent Hivemind — anti-Hybrian, born from the Draconic War
    • Built by: Possessed animals constructing a facility inside
    • Gold: Dragon hoards, imperial tribute — drives adventure economy
    • Related: Melberior, Fireborn, Julian the Dragon Tamer, The Draconic War
    • Danger Level: EXTREME — most who enter do not return
